summary: Keep ticket lifecycle writes independent of background index repair

delivery.outcome: Prevent background disposable projection repair from blocking authoritative ready/complete/fail writes; test and publish through native OneDev and independent Validator. Activate reviewed runtime separately.
nonGoals: Change synchronization paths owned by ticket-238
Change CAS, canonical receipt, terminal immutability or attempt semantics
Delete locks or terminate unknown owners

architecture.decision: Use existing independent cross-process index lock and optimistic source-signature retries; lifecycle exact reads fall back to durable records instead of rebuilding the disposable index.
architecture.rollback: Revert scoped source through protected delivery; preserve operational tickets, receipts and attempts.

validation.evidence: Paused background rebuild permits concurrent canonical lifecycle commit before release
Source race rebuilds and coalescing tests pass
Current and sharded stale-index lifecycle tests preserve states and counters

commands: python -m ruff check --no-cache planfile/__init__.py planfile/api/server.py tests/test_sqlite_ticket_index.py tests/test_ticket_execution.py
validation.evidence: Exact frozen head released before protected native OneDev and independent Validator publication
